audio.design: Deterministic dry plastic contact accents: softly filtered noise, three short nonharmonic body resonances, restrained secondary response, gentler release accents and subtle stereo placement. No music, speech or continuous background sound.
audio.synchronization: Beats at local peaks of actual locked source-pose channel velocity, merged for synchronous multi-finger motion. Softer release accents and sparse wrist-motion beats. These are authored sound accents, not measured mechanical contact events.
audio.auditionNote: Measured signal levels, spectrum, source-event timing and decoded AAC alignment were verified. No subjective listening claim is made.
